responsibility: Implements the core PA-RISC target backend logic in C++. This is the main owner of PA-specific target hooks and helper routines for RTL expansion, address legitimization, cost and scheduling decisions, frame layout, prologue/epilogue generation, argument passing, assembler/file-start emission, label and section encoding, builtins, branch-table output, and many insn-output helpers that pa.md templates call, consuming GCC RTL/tree state and producing PA-specific RTL decisions and assembly text.
same_name_distinction: C++ implementation body of the main PA backend: unlike pa.h it realizes target hooks and helper routines, unlike pa.md it is not the declarative RTL pattern database, and unlike pa.opt it does not define command-line options.
